messages:
anika: Heads-up — multiple customers flagged large invoice token spikes after yesterday's control-plane outage. Backfill replay started overnight; seems like a subset of accounts got duplicate events applied. Raising a triage thread.

support: Which customers are we seeing this on? Any enterprise accounts or is it broad?

anika: Early list: acme-inc (+42% tokens), northstar (+31%), beta-staging (internal test): +1200 tokens. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/ops?range=24h (redacted).

eli: Quick look at eventstore: consumer logs show the replay job reprocessed offsets 5523-6789 twice due to a retry loop while dedupe worker was paused. Sample query I ran:
```sql
SELECT event_id, count(*) as hits
FROM events
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-16T22:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-17T03:00:00Z'
GROUP BY event_id
HAVING hits > 1
LIMIT 10;
```
Result: ~2.3k dup event_ids in that window.

todd: Can we run a dry-run of the replay with dedupe enabled to see what would be skipped? Use the replay CLI:
```bash
./replay --start-offset 5523 --end-offset 6789 --dedupe=true --dry-run --log-level=debug
```
I'll stand by to examine output.

replay-bot: [automated] replay-job-20260317-01: started by ops, attempt=3, status=error (502 from eventstore)

eli: Pasting a couple of log lines showing duplicates:
```
2026-03-17T01:12:03Z consumer[replay]: processed event_id=0x7f1b3 dup_check=none -> inserting
2026-03-17T01:12:04Z consumer[replay]: processed event_id=0x7f1b3 dup_check=found -> skipping (but earlier insert completed despite retry)
```
Looks like race between insert+index creation and retry path. Dedupe worker was drained for the maintenance window.

billing: From a billing ops perspective we need to decide credits ASAP. Propose temporary credit for invoices with >10% unexpected delta while we reconcile. Who owns the customer list?

anika: I exported list and shared in private: ACME, NorthStar, Beta-staging, & 6 smaller dev orgs. Proposal: auto-credit token delta beyond expected baseline for that billing period, then reconcile post-dedupe.

sam: Triage plan: 1) Pause any automatic backfill/replay jobs (todd) 2) Re-enable dedupe worker and run consistency scan (eli) 3) Run targeted replay with --dedupe=true and verify idempotence (todd) 4) Re-run invoice aggregation and diff, prepare credits (billing) 5) Customer comms draft (support). Owner assignments: todd (pause/replay), eli (dedupe + scan), billing (credits), support (comms). ETA for step1-3: 3 hours.

anika: Assigning: @todd pause jobs + run dry-run now, @eli run dedupe scan and share counts, @billing prepare credit runbook. Check-ins at :clock3: in this thread. :white_check_mark:

support: Draft for customers (suggested): "We observed a replay-related duplication during maintenance which caused some accounts to show higher usage on invoices. We're pausing replay, running a de-duplication and reconciliation, and will apply credits where needed. ETA for resolution 24–48 hours. Contact support@redwood.ai if you need immediate help." Thoughts?

billing: That message looks good. We'll hold credits until we have final reconciliation but will flag impacted customers internally for priority handling.

eli: Running the dedupe scan now. First pass: found 2314 duplicated event_ids tied to 9 orgs. Sharing summary CSV to the private ops drive. Will post results in 30–45m.

todd: Dry-run finished — replay would have skipped ~2.2k events with --dedupe=true. Re-enabling dedupe worker now, then re-run replay in a controlled window. Logs attached.

anika: Thanks all. Please update thread with any new findings. I'll coordinate customer comms and follow up with a post-incident reconciliation doc after we confirm the final numbers.

support: Noted — prepping customer messages and support queue tags.

sam: After reconciliation, we should add an automated guard to prevent replay retries while dedupe worker state != healthy. Filing a follow-up ticket. :memo:
